notes.subject: diphapo
notes.rationale: כליות ke diphapo tse di feletseng; ba fetoleli bangwe ba akanya `boteng jwa me` — Sethebera se bua ka diphapo ka bonna

notes.subject: קנית
notes.rationale: `bopa` kgatlhanong le `go reka/ago` — KJV `possessed`, JPS `made`; leina le bothata fa e le go bopa

notes.subject: o nkokeditse
notes.rationale: סכך go aga setlhareng/go bokolola — `go khubeka` mo Setswana

notes.subject: wa
notes.rationale: Sehebera se na le `אמי` fela; `wa` o okeditswe go tlhalosa tiro ya `בבטן`

translation: Gore wena o ne wa bopa diphapo tsa me, o nkokeditse mo mpeng wa mme ⟨wa⟩ me.
